name: UGC Math Race
desc:
🌈 Welcome to Math Block Race!
Every 1 second you will gain 1 time which you can use to unlock the UGC!

🔢 How to play:
1. Run to the finish line without falling.
2. Stand on the right answer before the timer hits zero.
3. Players who get to the end win 1 trophy!

✨ Use code "35KLIKES" and LIKE the game to get 1,035 FREE time!
👍 NEW CODE will release once the game gets 40,000 LIKES!
